question: Which goddesses are invoked to protect the feet and ears?
premises: The Brahman-consisting goddess is invoked for the feet
The mistress of the world is invoked for the ears
inference: The Brahman-consisting goddess is asked to protect the feet and the mistress of the world the ears.
plain_english: May the Brahman-consisting goddess protect the feet, and may the mistress of the world protect the ears.
